mapper.sql: j.id AS id, j.file_id AS file_id, j.printer_id AS printer_id, j.user_id AS user_id, j.operator_id AS operator_id, j.priority AS priority, j.status AS status, j.progress AS progress, j.started_at AS started_at, j.completed_at AS completed_at, j.error_reason AS error_reason, j.created_at AS created_at, j.updated_at AS updated_at, f.original_name AS file_name, p.name AS printer_name, p.machine_number AS machine_number, creator_user.username AS creator_username, operator_user.username AS operator_username, f.material_type AS material_type, f.nozzle_size AS nozzle_size

FROM farm_print_job j LEFT JOIN farm_print_file f ON f.id = j.file_id LEFT JOIN farm_printer p ON p.id = j.printer_id LEFT JOIN farm_user creator_user ON creator_user.id = j.user_id LEFT JOIN farm_user operator_user ON operator_user.id = j.operator_id
mapper.select:
SELECT
WHERE j.status = 'QUEUED'
AND j.user_id = #{userId}
ORDER BY j.priority DESC, j.created_at ASC, j.id ASC
